# Examples

## Purpose

Consumer-facing runnable examples, integration examples, and safe sample configurations live here.

## Owner

SDKWork Commerce maintainers own this directory. Changes must follow the repository `AGENTS.md` entrypoint and the canonical SDKWork specs under `../sdkwork-specs/`.

## Allowed Content

- Safe SDK/API examples.
- Sample configs with placeholders only.
- Runnable demos that are not promoted to application roots.

## Forbidden Content

- Live credentials, tokens, customer data, production endpoints, generated SDK transport output, or app-owned runtime state.

## Related Specs

- `../sdkwork-specs/SDKWORK_WORKSPACE_SPEC.md`
- `../sdkwork-specs/DOCUMENTATION_SPEC.md`
- `../sdkwork-specs/SDK_SPEC.md`
- `../sdkwork-specs/TEST_SPEC.md`

## Verification

Examples must match public exports and SDK method surfaces; run relevant SDK or package tests when examples change.
